args.question: Before I write chapter 3: if "lighter" means the emotional tone, the scene would keep the quiet stakes but add more ease and humour between Lena, Oren and Suri; if it means the lighting, I would set the scene in brighter daylight in the museum hall and keep the tone as it is. Which do you mean?
options: Lighter emotional tone (more ease between the characters)
Lighter lighting (brighter daylight in the hall), tone unchanged
Both: brighter daylight and an easier tone
